name: Subjects
description: The subjects taught at the school

subjects.name: Charms
subjects.description: The study of spells that alter objects without changing their fundamental nature.

subjects.name: Potions
subjects.description: The art of brewing magical mixtures with various effects.

subjects.name: Defense Against the Dark Arts
subjects.description: Defensive spells and counter-curses to protect against dark magic.

subjects.name: Transfiguration
subjects.description: The transformation of objects and beings into different forms.

subjects.name: Herbology
subjects.description: The study of magical plants and fungi and their properties.
